text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected in router cluster 'us-west-2-router-pool' starting 3405559860. SLO p99 breached (target 300ms -> observed 2.1s). Streaming stalls reported. Auto-escalation to incidents channel. :rotating_light:
priya: I'm on it. grabbing traces and heatmaps now. @alex please be prepared for handoff in 15 if this is a livepage.
alex: standing by, thanks @priya. any indication of config rollout?
incident-bot: Recent config rollouts: routing-policy v4 -> deployed to 40% of traffic at 3405559400. Canary flagged: LB weight redistribution + new hash bucketing.
jamie: seeing a cluster of sessions pinned to a small set of router backends -> hot partitions. tails line up with the new weight distribution.
morgan: confirmed streaming stalls correlate with hot shards in us-west-2 and eu-west-2 neighbor affinity skew. Connection queues building.
priya: quick mitigation options: 1) pause routing-policy v4 rollout (stop canary), 2) revert to v3, 3) apply temporary sticky routing to spread keys, 4) eject hot pods. I recommend pause then apply sticky. Thoughts?
alex: +1 pause rollout first. If pause alone doesn't shrink tails in 2-3 mins, escalate to revert.
jamie: running live query of router histograms: ```
# show tail latency by backend
SELECT backend_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms FROM router_latency WHERE region='us-west-2' ORDER BY p99_ms DESC LIMIT 10
```
morgan: sample output shows backend b-84 and b-91 p99 > 3s, p95 ~1s. other backends normal.
priya: executing pause: `/rollout control routing-policy v4 pause --canary-id=canary-3429` -> output: paused, traffic stops shifting.
oncall-bot: Handoff: @priya -> @alex in 12m. Livepage severity: S2 (customer-impacting p99 breaches, partial degradation). Recommend SRE oncall to join call if tails persist.
cs-lead: seeing customer alerts from two customers in org-prod: streaming sessions dropped, RU spike. CS prepping outreach.
alex: running an on-the-fly redistribute to relieve b-84 and b-91: `curl -XPOST https://router-admin.local/evict?backend=b-84&force=true` -> queued.
jamie: evict call returned 202, new connections started rebalancing, but KV cache locality causing cold starts increasing per-request latency for a minute.
morgan: applied temporary sticky routing policy: `PATCH /policy/sticky` with `max_shard=64` changed -> rollout 100% in 30s. This spreads keys across more backends rather than concentrically hashing.
priya: monitoring: p99 down from 2.1s -> 650ms at 3405559960, p95 ~220ms. Streaming stall rate decreased ~70%.
alex: good. next steps: 1) keep v4 paused, 2) schedule controlled rollback for next maintenance window OR run detailed sim to reproduce v4 hash mapping, 3) run per-customer incidents for those hit.
jamie: collecting traces for RCA: attaching head sample stack for b-84 (first 120s): ```
TRACE b-84:
- accept -> auth (30ms)
- lookup kv-cache miss -> 420ms
- backend queuing 800ms
- tokenization wait 30ms
```
priya: oncall-bot, please open a livepage bridge: `@oncall-bot create-bridge incident-3405559876`
oncall-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.company/incident-3405559876. Participants: priy a, alex, jamie, morgan, cs-lead.
cs-lead: outreach message draft ready: "We're investigating elevated latency impacting streaming sessions in US-WEST and EU-WEST regions. Mitigation in progress; we'll update in 30 minutes." Approve to send?
alex: yes send. include mitigation steps and ETA 30m.
priya: timeline note for thread: root cause likely routing-policy v4 hash+bucketing change + rollout overlap causing hot partitioning and region skew. Need full verification with deterministic replay.
morgan: enacting follow-ups: 1) disable automatic canary acceleration, 2) add safety limit to max weight delta per backend, 3) add observability: per-policy heatmap alarm.
jamie: assigning action items: - jamie: collect full lt histograms + traces (in progress). - morgan: config patch to throttle weight diffs (PR queued). - alex: lead rollback plan if sim reproduces. - priy a: coordinate customer comms and close bridge when stabilized.
priya: last check: p99 3405560140 -> 320ms; streaming stalls minimal. I'll close bridge in 10 if stable.
cs-lead: sending a follow-up to effected customers with current status.
alex: thanks team. open RCA ticket tkt-INC-3405559876 and link traces. leaving the channel; if tails spike again ping me. :thumbsup:
priya: handing back to rotation oncall: @eng-sre-rotation you're up for postmortem & follow-ups. Closing livepage in 8m unless regressions.
eng-sre-rotation: acknowledged. Will take postmortem and track mitigations to completion.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, rollout paused. status=stabilized. next update scheduled in 2h for RCA draft.
